name: ClayCodeEffectTransformationContract
principles: effect ordering/dependency is not capability authority
reordering is allowed only when the declared conflict relation proves commutation and observable outcomes are preserved
BASE may use exact total traces first; partial-order equivalence is a later optimization permission, never an authority relaxation

transformation_rules.duplicate: only proven pure operations; effectful duplication forbidden in BASE
transformation_rules.reorder: only nonconflicting effects with data/control/transaction dependencies preserved
transformation_rules.speculate: only explicitly speculatable operations; authority/commit/rollback/error boundaries default NO
transformation_rules.hoist_sink: requires preserved conflict order, authority-decision timing and error/reentry semantics

candidate_equivalence: Source ~= Target iff Obs is equivalent for all admitted inputs/capability states; effect order may quotient only explicitly commuting/disjoint events.
language_change_policy: No core syntax change proposed. Implement in typed effect/lowering/runtime/validation layers first; only an executable counterexample may force a frozen semantic amendment.
